en: Color postcard showing a river winding through a tree-filled valley with the snow‑tipped Făgăraș Mountains beyond. Reverse side bears a 40‑bani Romanian stamp marked "R.P. ROMINA," postmarks from Călimănești (Reg. Argeș) dated 25.8.67 and from București dated 26.8.67, a vertical imprint of the national tourism office, a multilingual caption naming the Olt Valley and Făgăraș Massif, and a handwritten Romanian message and address to Bucharest.
